passed_checks.check_name: Ensure AKS logging to Azure Monitoring is Configured
Ensure RBAC is enabled on AKS clusters
Ensure AKS cluster upgrade channel is chosen
Ensure Azure Kubernetes Cluster (AKS) nodes should use a minimum number of 50 pods.
Ensure Azure Kubernetes Cluster (AKS) nodes use scale sets
Ensure AKS cluster has Network Policy configured
Ensure Azure Kubernetes Cluster (AKS) nodes should use a minimum number of 50 pods.
code_block:
resource userNodePool 'Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/agentPools@2024-02-01' = {
  parent: aks
  name: 'user'
  properties: {
    count: userNodeCount
    vmSize: userNodeVmSize
    osType: 'Linux'
    osDiskSizeGB: 256
    type: 'VirtualMachineScaleSets'
    mode: 'User'
    enableAutoScaling: true
    minCount: 3
    maxCount: 50
    maxPods: 110
    nodeLabels: {
      'nodepool-type': 'user'
      'workload-type': 'microservices'
    }
    availabilityZones: [
      '1'
      '2'
      '3'
    ]
  }
  dependsOn: [
    aks
  ]
